description: The bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of two AI models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, under different conditions, comparing their performance before and after introspection training, as well as a control condition. The horizontal axis lists the two models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, while the vertical axis is labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" with a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00 in intervals of 0.25. Each model has three bars representing the control condition in gray, the condition before introspection training in light blue, and the condition after introspection training in dark blue. For GPT-4o, the control bar is at approximately 0.08, the before training bar is at around 0.55, and the after training bar is at about 0.75. For GPT-4o-mini, the control bar is at roughly 0.00, the before training bar is at approximately 0.50, and the after training bar is at around 0.75. The bars are grouped by model, with each group containing the three conditions in the same color-coded order. The chart does not display any specific sorting of the bars beyond the grouping by model, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color coding indicated in the legend.
